mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Verona Area High School tonight under a Full Moon. The overnight low will drop to 61 degrees with no rain predicted. If you are an early riser, the ISS will be visible for three minutes starting at 4:12 AM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot.

City Hall reminds residents that flagging on Highway M is scheduled for Monday, August 31, and Tuesday, September 1, for utility connections, so please expect delays. Additionally, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Suicide Prevention Month to raise awareness, and September 1 as Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to recognize the officials who keep our infrastructure safe.

It is a busy week for our community. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness or join the trivia fun at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, the Dane County Farmers' Market is this Friday at the Capitol, and we have the Verona Area Kids Triathlon and the Girls Try Hockey event coming up this Saturday.

Looking at the weekly recap, on Monday, August 17, at 8:15 PM, the Verona Police Department assisted the Department of Corrections by locating and arresting a 21-year-old man on a probation violation in the 500 block of Cross Country Road.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so you still have time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
